scenes.text: Did you know there is a fifty-square-mile zone in Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically get away with any crime without ever going to jail?
This crazy legal loophole exists because this specific strip of land sits in Idaho but remains under the federal jurisdiction of Wyoming, creating a bizarre constitutional overlap.

Under the Sixth Amendment, you have the right to a trial by a jury from the state and district where the crime happened, but since absolutely zero people live in this intersection, forming a jury is physically impossible.
Congress has known about this terrifying lawless zone for decades but has never fixed it, so tell me if you would ever dare to camp here and follow for more wild facts!
